From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: buying readiness, signer mapping & marketplace interest (BrightPath)

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same checklist. Nice meeting Tom, Alice.

Key takeaways from today:
- Use case: internal search + customer support summarization (pilot scope = 3 models, 6 mo).
- Expected pilot timing: target start early May; decision window by end of April.
- Performance SLOs discussed (95th pct < 200ms for short prompts) — we'll provide perf matrix.
- Primary commercial path options: Direct purchase (PO + invoicing) OR cloud marketplace listing (Procurement prefers marketplace if available).

Immediate asks from BrightPath we agreed on:
1) Who is the economic buyer? (name/title)
2) Who is the finance sponsor that signs off on invoices/PO?
3) Who is the legal/signatory contact for contract execution and DO they require an internal PO template?
4) Any vendor onboarding form or security questionnaire we should pre-fill?

Attachments: redwood-pilot-MVP-scope.pdf (high-level scope + pricing bands)

Proposed next steps:
- Tom/Alice: confirm budget owner, finance approver, preferred billing method (PO vs card) and whether marketplace listing would speed procurement.
- Redwood (me + Vivek): send PO vs card checklist, sample SOW template, and vendor onboarding stub.
- Target: align contacts by 03/25 so procurement can schedule intake.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@brightpath.ai>

Cc: Alice Moran <alice.moran@brightpath.ai>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: buying readiness, signer mapping & marketplace interest (BrightPath)

Thanks Camila — good summary and appreciated the clear checklist. Answers inline: 

- Economic buyer: Mike Alvarez (CTO) — mike.alvarez@brightpath.ai (owns budget for infra/AI).
- Finance sponsor: Alice Moran — will route PO approvals and budgeting.
- Legal/signatory: procurement@brightpath.ai (Maria Lopez is our procurement lead; she is the signer on contracts > $50k).
- PO vs card: For pilots of this size BrightPath prefers issuing a PO and net-30 invoices. We can do card for quick POC under $5k but not our standard pilot spend.
- Marketplace: Yes — if Redwood is available on CloudMarket (our internal marketplace) it shortens procurement by ~2 weeks. Please advise if you support listing.

Procurement asked for the following documents to attach to the intake:
- Standard SOW (or SOW template)
- Vendor W-9 / tax info if contracted in the US
- Vendor onboarding form (their intake workbook)

I'll loop Maria on a new thread if you need direct procurement intake. Thanks — Tom

Hi Tom / Maria — Vivek here from Redwood (Head of Solutions). Thanks for the quick answers earlier. A couple of operational items so legal/procurement can triage quickly: 

1) I attached our vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx to this thread for you to review — happy to pre-fill any fields you indicate are required.
2) For billing, we support net-30 invoicing on PO, monthly or one-time invoice for pilot; yearly prepay available if you want committed Dedicated capacity.
3) Marketplace listing: we can initiate CloudMarket onboarding. If BrightPath prefers marketplace procurement, we can prioritize the listing to hit your internal deadline (typically ~10 business days once procurement provides required vendor details).

Next steps suggestion (short):
- Maria: can you confirm receipt of the attached onboarding workbook and indicate any mandatory fields (tax ID, insurance cert, contact for 1099) by 03/22?
- Tom/Alice: confirm Mike's approval path (direct sign-off vs delegated).
